name: qkd_ahub_die-hp4-COMMIT
purpose: KV-AHUB hp4: ot_qkd_ahub_die parent re-plan: one clock entry + spine H-tree over the 14 closed children, regional reset pipe, dataflow-column floorplan

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qkd_ahub_die #(.SI_RLY(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DQKD_AHUB_ONE_CK --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_core.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles_bb.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_recip_leaf_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_die/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_die/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_die --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qkd_ahub_die --macro-view physical/ref_tile/nhb_pbst_ref/views/ot_nhb_pbst --macro-view physical/ref_tile/nhb_pvlg_ref/views/ot_nhb_pvlg --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_zh_m5/views/ot_nhb_zh --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_core/views/qkd_ahub_core --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkh_recip_ref/views/ot_qkh_recip_leaf > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: hp4 (KV-AHUB 10-17): hp3 gate FAIL (GRT ov 11; pre-route setup -845 = rst_n port -> pbst rst_n, reg->pbst ra -302 over ~915 um, u_sr -165; 21 clock entries with unbuffered entry wires: child pin arrivals 11-2,424 ps, slew up to 7.7 ns; ck_si 492/98.5). Structural: (1) ONE regional clock entry ck + balanced spine H-tree with child-insertion leaf targets over all 14 hard children and the relay flops (RTL define QKD_AHUB_ONE_CK, 0 cycles): the zero-relay core<->zh/pvlg/pbst hops fixed by the closed core's latency parameters are timed on one propagated tree instead of paying the per-entry die-skew reserve (150-210 setup / 100 hold); (2) regional reset ot_rst_pipe 14 regions x 3 stages (equal release edge for every child); (3) re-placed children in dataflow columns: lanes contiguous (crossbar span 1,080 -> 713 um), core over the pvlg row centre, worst unregistered core->child hop ~650 um (was ~915).
